overview: The paper proposes AutoDV, an end-to-end graph transformer-based deep learning model that leverages multi-scale graphs and affine invariant losses to learn high-dimensional data visualization mappings from historical datasets, eliminating the need for hyperparameter tuning and iterative optimization on new datasets.

modules.name: Data Subsampling and Cleaning
modules.description: Implements Algorithm 3 for generating subsets of varying sizes and class combinations from source datasets, and filters out subsets with low clustering performance or rare classes to ensure training data quality.

modules.name: Ground Truth Embedding Optimization
modules.description: Executes Bayesian Optimization to find optimal hyperparameters (perplexity for t-SNE, n_neighbors for UMAP) for each subset and generates the corresponding target low-dimensional embeddings (Z*) as training labels.

modules.name: Multi-Scale Graph Construction
modules.description: Computes k-scale weighted adjacency matrices using Gaussian kernels with varying bandwidths from high-dimensional data points to capture structural information at different scales.

modules.name: Positional Encoding Extraction
modules.description: Computes Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on the similarity matrices to generate graph positional encodings, followed by a sign-count-based flipping strategy to resolve eigenvector sign ambiguity.

modules.name: AutoDV Model Architecture
modules.description: Implements the multi-graph neural network pipeline consisting of independent Graph Isomorphism Networks (GINs) for each scale graph, feature concatenation, a Graph Transformer layer for inter-node relationship exploration, and an MLP head for dimensionality reduction.

modules.name: Affine Invariant Loss Calculation
modules.description: Calculates pairwise similarity matrices for predicted and ground truth embeddings, and computes the specific Bregman divergence loss variants (KLD for t-SNE, Local/Global consistency loss with decaying regularization for UMAP) to align geometric structures.

modules.name: Model Training Workflow
modules.description: Manages the end-to-end training loop, including batch construction with fixed node limits, integration with the AdamW optimizer, cosine annealing learning rate scheduling, and handling of pre-computed positional encodings.

modules.name: Large-Scale Batch Inference
modules.description: Implements the batch-based inference method for large datasets, using KMeans to define a fixed anchor set, processing data chunks combined with the anchor, and calibrating the output embeddings.

modules.name: Visualization and Metric Evaluation
modules.description: Calculates comprehensive clustering and dimensionality reduction metrics (NMI, SC, Trustworthiness, Continuity, Rank Correlation, Triplet preservation) and provides functionality for plotting 2D/3D visualization results.

modules.name: Baseline Methods Integration
modules.description: Implementation wrappers and configurations for baseline methods including PCA, Autoencoder, Parametric UMAP, Inductive t-SNE, and Inductive UMAP to facilitate comparative experiments.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis
modules.description: Configuration runners for systematically evaluating component choices and hyperparameters, including different Positional Encodings (LapPE, NMF, RRWP, SignNet), sign flipping strategies, loss functions, and sensitivity to the number of graphs (k) and PE dimensions.

modules.name: Generalization and Robustness Testing
modules.description: Scripts for evaluating cross-domain transferability, testing on synthetic manifold data (Swiss Roll, Mammoth), and injecting varying types (global/local) and levels of noise to analyze the model's stability and generalization boundaries.
